memories.content: The founder knows that Tidepool's head of support privately confirmed that some critical reviews were taken down. The founder has received email inquiries from two journalists about the viral thread. The founder must decide whether to post a public response.

A viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews has gained two million views and includes screenshots that appear genuine. The thread is publicly visible. The founder has the ability to post a public response on the same platform.
